## Azure App Service Plan Instance

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

**[1] `azure.app_service_plan.instance.name`:** Applies to Azure apps hosted on App Service plans, including, but not limited to,
App Service web apps and some Azure Functions. Detectors SHOULD set it from the first
non-empty value of the `COMPUTERNAME`, `WEBSITE_POD_NAME`, and `CONTAINER_NAME`
environment variables.

This is one of two values Azure uses as an app's instance. It is not to be confused
with `WEBSITE_INSTANCE_ID`, which detectors use for `service.instance.id` or
`faas.instance`. Apps on the same plan that run on the same instance report the same
value.
